goals.title: 为 Aether 管理后台新增完整备份记录查看能力：管理员执行完整备份导出时记录后台任务运行状态；新增只读接口返回最近备份记录；系统设置页...
goals.objective: 为 Aether 管理后台新增完整备份记录查看能力：管理员执行完整备份导出时记录后台任务运行状态；新增只读接口返回最近备份记录；系统设置页面展示最近备份是否成功、数量和时间等信息。复用现有 background_task_runs，不新增数据库表。

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP happy path: trigger GET /api/admin/system/data/export in a gateway integration test, then query GET /api/admin/system/backup-runs and observe one admin.system.data_export run with status=succeeded, started/finished timestamps, progress=100, and result summary including exported byte count.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-http-backup-runs.txt containing command output/test transcript plus response/status JSON excerpt
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: artifact: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-http-backup-runs.txt; refreshed backend focused run prints backup-runs JSON after complete export with status=succeeded, progress_percent=100, payload.scope=complete_backup, result.exported_bytes>0, config_data/user_data absent, created_by present. cleanup: no persistent server; test aborts local handles; target-codex-clean is a local build dir.

successCriteria.scenario: Boundary path: GET /api/admin/system/backup-runs before any complete backup run returns HTTP 200 with items=[], total=0, page/page_size metadata, and no malformed task statuses; route classifier recognizes backup_runs as admin:system.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-empty-and-classification.txt containing focused route-classification test output and empty-list response evidence
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: artifacts: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-empty-and-classification.txt and .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-failure-record.txt; refreshed backend focused run confirms route classification admin_proxy/system_manage/backup_runs/admin:system, exact task_key filtering excludes near-match admin.system.data_export.extra and unrelated admin.provider.delete, safe response whitelist drops seeded payload.secret and result.user_data, empty page preserves total, and failure path records one failed run with progress_message 完整备份导出失败, error_message, result null. cleanup: no persistent server; test aborts local handles; target-codex-clean is a local build dir.

successCriteria.scenario: Frontend/regression: SystemSettings renders a 备份记录 section fed by the backup-runs API, shows latest success/failure/time/count and empty state, while existing DataManagement complete backup export wiring remains callable.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-frontend-render.txt containing Vitest/typecheck output or browser screenshot/test transcript for SystemSettings backup-record section
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: artifacts: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-frontend-render.txt and .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C003-frontend-typecheck.txt; refreshed Vitest 5 tests passed (recent summary, empty state, load error, populated DOM, empty/error DOM) and vue-tsc --noEmit passed. Browser screenshot not captured because no Chrome/Chromium/Playwright available in this restricted environment. cleanup: no dev server/browser spawned.

goals.blockedReason: Codex goal 已以功能目标文案 complete，但 ulw-loop 期望 plan 级目标文案，二者账本对齐不通过。功能本身已全部实现并验证通过（4 后端测试 + 5 前端测试，三位审查者 APPROVE，无阻塞）。此为 Codex goal 与 ulw-loop 的对齐摩擦，非功能缺陷。
